Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the firm’s field was “Private Equity advisory” based on a misreading of the site navigation (Industries > Private Capital) rather than extracting the firm’s actual services. This ignored both the task requirement to identify the firm’s service field and the evidence on the Egon Zehnder site/meta (organizational consulting and leadership advisory) and well-known core offerings (Executive Search, Board Consulting). The Planner failed to follow its own instruction to quote the exact services from the firm’s site and finalized an incorrect answer.
